title: Fuel snapshots in 1970, 2000 and 2024
caption: Absolute consumption in TWh. Unavailable categories are explicitly labelled, not assigned zero. No pie normalisation conceals missing or out-of-scope fuel components.

title: Year-on-year sector changes
caption: Changes calculated from reported sector totals, 1971–2024. A descriptive annual comparison; no attribution to weather, policy or efficiency is inferred.

title: Annual sector correlation
caption: 55 annual observations, 1970–2024. This is not the original notebook matrix, which correlated aggregated fuel profiles across sectors. Co-trending levels and autocorrelation limit interpretation; no causal claim.

title: Major fuel trajectories
caption: National delivered-fuel categories from All final users. Unlike an all-sector sum, this does not count aggregate and component sectors together.

title: Matched chronological model comparison
caption: New total-consumption experiment, not dissertation reproduction. The same 22/20/18 origin-target pairs are used at 1/3/5-year horizons. Fixed ARIMA has the lowest error here; no statistical significance is claimed.

title: Actual versus predicted on matched years
caption: 22 one-year forecasts per model for target years 2003–2024. Current-vintage annual observations are assumed available at each origin. No future exogenous data or original dissertation target groups are used.

title: Historical forecast uncertainty diagnostic
caption: Nominal 80% prior-error bands, withheld until ten errors have matured. Only 12/8/4 bands per model are evaluable. Longer-horizon undercoverage and dependent errors prevent a calibrated 80% coverage claim; no future forecast is shown.
status: Verified separate historical backtest; exploratory uncertainty
